team.abilityDesc: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.desc: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.desc: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.desc: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.
mechanics: Retroceso: pierde el 33% del daño causado

moves.name: Astonish
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by jumping out and startling the opponent. This attack hits first and makes the target flinch, but it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Spark
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.desc: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.
